name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.TwoSided.decoded_defect_attack
title: Decoded-defect attack on a two-sided hidden row: an overcomplete pad combination isolates the planted noise defect
statement: Over a field, let c x be pad rows indexed by prefixes x, D0 D1 invertible, E0 E1 matrices, e x prefix noises and f0 f1 vectors. If c t lies in the span of the c x with x different from t, there is alpha with alpha t = 1 such that sum_x alpha x • ((c x E0 + e x D0) D0⁻¹ - (c x E1 + e x D1) D1⁻¹) = 0 and the same sum with f0 (resp. f1) added to the t-th child-0 (resp. child-1) term equals f0 D0⁻¹ - f1 D1⁻¹.
